Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1359
Claimant:
Alyssa Gutierrez
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
2023-04-15
Claim opened after a report that the insured vehicle was struck while turning left at an intersection. The claimant
reports a wrist injury from the impact and is represented by counsel, who has asked that all contact go through their
office.
2023-06-07
Confirmed that the driver is named on the policy and that the policy was in force on the reported date. Requested the
police report and photographs from the scene.
2023-07-02
Police report received. It confirms the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of the collision, and the responding
officer's account matches the reported manner of impact.
2023-08-12
Scene photographs reviewed. They show the points of contact and confirm several details of the reported collision,
though they do not show the moment of impact itself.
2023-08-16
Attempted to locate independent witnesses through the police report and the scene canvass. None were identified, so
the account rests on the parties and the physical evidence.
2023-08-18
Medical records received showing a wrist fracture. The kind of fracture and the force it implies are consistent with the
reported crash.
2023-08-23
Treatment followed a usual course, with follow-up visits tapering as the calimant improved. No earlier injury to the
same body area appears in the records we have obtained so far.
2023-08-24
Claimant's account was taken aagin through counsel. The description of the collision and the injury has stayed the
same in every conversation so far.
2023-09-19
Prior vehicle records were pulled. They show major damage to the same areas from an earlier accident that was
never reported to us, and the current claim presents that damage as new.
2023-10-16
Reviewed the overlap between the earlier damage and the current claim. It is not yet clear whether all of the claimed
damage came from this impact. Ntohing so far suggests the damage occurred before coverage began.
2023-10-31
Referred to the supervisor for a decision on next steps. Further inquiry is needed on the prior damage and the extent
of the current loss before any settlement discussion with counsel.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
